mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to construct a world where two AccessAttempts share the same AuditEntry — i.e., an audit entry is 'reused' or overwritten. The injection forces exactly that scenario, which the AppendOnly and FR_010_AuditImmutable assertions must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj a1, a2: AccessAttempt | some a1.auditEntry and a1.auditEntry = a2.auditEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an AccessAttempt to be marked Permitted even when no active CareTeamMembership exists for the (clinician, patient) pair. The injection forces a permitted attempt with no matching active membership, which the OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_006_CareTeamGating assertions must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.kind = RecordsLookup and a.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = a.caller and m.status = Active and (some p: Patient | p = a.patientRef.resolves and m.forPatient = p)) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Denied attempt to return OkResponse instead of NotFoundResponse, leaking the existence of the patient to the caller. The injection forces exactly this leak, which NoInformationLeakage and FR_007_ByteEquivalentResponse must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Denied and a.response = OkResponse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Permitted AccessAttempt to have no audit entry (auditEntry = none). The injection forces a permitted attempt with no associated AuditEntry, which AuditCompleteness and FR_008_AlwaysOnAudit must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and no a.auditEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Doctor (or other clinical role) to invoke AuditSearch, violating the separation between clinical access and audit inspection. The injection forces exactly this privilege violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_IGAccessViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.kind = AuditSearch and a.caller.role = Doctor }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an AuditEntry to record a different clinician than the one who performed the access, or a mismatched role snapshot. The injection forces misattribution by decoupling forClinician in the entry from the caller in the attempt.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributionViolation { some a: AccessAttempt, e: AuditEntry | a.auditEntry = e and e.forClinician != a.caller }
